heroHeadline: CIA Director's Unannounced Moscow Visit Prompts Ukrainian Pause on Strikes Against Russian Capital
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,644, CIA Director John Ratcliffe made a rare, unannounced visit to Moscow on Aug 25, prompting Kyiv to agree to a temporary Aug 24-26 pause on strikes against Moscow and St. Petersburg at Washington's request; the Kremlin said Ratcliffe held talks 'at the intelligence agencies' level' without meeting Putin. Overnight into Aug 25, Russia hit five oblasts with an Iskander-M missile, a Kh-31P missile, and ~150 drones, damaging a power facility that cut electricity to 30,000+ subscribers in Chernihiv district and Slavutych; separate Geran-3 drone strikes that evening injured 11 across Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia. Ukraine answered with long-range drone strikes on the Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar (2 killed) and the Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov Oblast, then on Aug 26 hit 16 targets across Russia including a Wildberries logistics hub in Tambov Oblast (destroyed by fire) and the NORSI refinery in Nizhny Novgorod, with drone strikes killing 3 in Lipetsk and Belgorod oblasts. Russian military losses reached ~1,480,750 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff.
